I asked the reception staff for assistance which was immediate. One of the staff pressed a panic button and then came out to help us and was swiftly joined by doctors, nurses and the practice paramedic. My wife was quickly taken to an unused consulting room and laid onto the couch and given medical treatment which was kind, compassionate and efficient.
